plan.summary: This 4-week block is the first part of a 12-week off-camp boxing plan built for one weekly S&C session with bodyweight-only equipment. Week 1 establishes a simple strength baseline with a push-up assessment so later work has a clear starting point. The main program starts in Week 2 and builds general lower-body power, upper-body strength endurance, trunk strength, and short conditioning without creating too much soreness for boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general strength, power, trunk stiffness, and repeat-effort conditioning with simple bodyweight work that is easy to recover from.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the same movement patterns with slightly harder variations and tighter work density while keeping quality high.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength and power, then express them with faster, sharper, lower-fatigue work that supports boxing speed.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Land softly and reset between reps. Jump fast and crisp, not tired.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the countermovement jump feels uncoordinated. Pause briefly at the bottom, then jump hard.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.reps: AMRAP stopping 1 rep before form breaks
exercises.notes: This set establishes your current pressing baseline. Warm up with a few easy sets first, then do one best clean set with full-body tension and a straight line from head to heel.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up with a few easy sets, then perform one hard set of clean push-ups and stop one rep before form breaks. Log the reps completed so the app can track your baseline.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat your Week 1 clean rep total over time without shortening range or losing body position.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are not yet clean. Choose a height that lets you get strong, full-range reps.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a slow lower and stay balanced. Front foot stays flat and torso stays tall.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if split squats bother your knees or feel awkward. Step back under control and drive up smoothly.

exercises.name: Table Row
exercises.notes: Pull your chest toward the edge and keep your body rigid. Stop each set before your hips sag or you have to jerk.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Towel Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure setup only. Keep the reps smooth and controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you do not have a safe row setup. Brace hard and row the load to your hip.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Press your lower back into the floor and keep your ribs down. Shorten the lever if you lose position.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hold is too hard to keep clean. Move slowly and keep your back flat.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Conditioning
exercises.notes: Stay relaxed and sharp. Move your feet, change levels, and keep the punches snappy rather than muscular.

endurancePrescription.rest: 1 minute easy walk and breathing between rounds

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Every rep should look the same. Stop if the jump height clearly drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the countermovement jump still feels too uncoordinated. Keep it simple and explosive.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 reps in reserve on every set. Full range and solid trunk position on every rep.

performanceTarget.prompt: Build the top clean set toward the high end of the range before making the variation harder.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are not yet strong enough for clean sets in this range.

substitutionOptions.name: Tempo Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a 3-second lower if regular push-ups are too easy but you do not have load.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Control the descent, pause briefly at the bottom, then stand up with intent.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if split squats feel cramped or uncomfortable. Keep the front leg stable.

exercises.name: Table Row
exercises.notes: Lead with the chest and squeeze at the top. Keep the neck neutral and the hips up.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Towel Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Only use a solid, safe anchor point. Keep tension through the whole body.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no safe row setup is available. Brace and avoid twisting.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Drive through the whole foot and finish with the glute, not your lower back.

substitutionOptions.name: Two-Leg Glute Bridge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg work feels unstable. Pause at the top for a full second.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stay long from head to heel and do not let the hips roll back.

substitutionOptions.name: Hard Front Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the side plank position is too shaky. Squeeze glutes and abs hard.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Conditioning
exercises.notes: Stay technical while breathing under control. Keep the feet active and the hands returning fast.

endurancePrescription.rest: 1 minute easy walk and breathing between rounds

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Explode on each rep and stick the landing. Rest enough to keep the jumps quick.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the countermovement jump still feels messy. Prioritize clean takeoff and landing.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Stop with 1-2 reps in reserve. If all sets are easy and clean, elevate the feet slightly next block rather than rushing now.

performanceTarget.prompt: Own the high end of the range with clean reps and steady body position.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the floor variation still breaks down before the target range.

substitutionOptions.name: Tempo Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a slower lower if standard push-ups are too easy and you need more challenge.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Only use this if you can stay balanced and pain-free. Move under control and drive up hard.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the elevated version feels unstable. Clean reps matter more than difficulty.

exercises.name: Table Row
exercises.notes: Pause briefly at the top and lower under control. No kicking or shrugging.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Towel Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a secure setup and keep the movement smooth.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you still do not have a safe body row option.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Keep the pelvis level and avoid twisting. Squeeze hard at the top for a full second.

substitutionOptions.name: Two-Leg Glute Bridge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if single-leg reps lose control. Make the squeeze stronger instead.

exercises.name: Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep the lower back pressed down the whole time. If that position goes, end the set.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the hollow hold is still too demanding to keep clean.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Conditioning
exercises.notes: Make this look like relaxed boxing, not survival work. Hands come back fast and breathing stays steady.

endurancePrescription.rest: 1 minute easy walk and breathing between rounds

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Keep the jumps fast and fresh. This week is for quality, not fatigue.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it feels cleaner. Keep every rep crisp.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve and keep every rep clean. This is a lighter week to recover and absorb the work.

performanceTarget.prompt: Match strong, clean reps without grinding. Save a little in the tank this week.

substitutionOptions.name: Incline Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you need an easier variation to stay crisp and fresh.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Smooth reps only. Keep balance and control from start to finish.

substitutionOptions.name: Reverse Lunge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it feels friendlier on the knees.

exercises.name: Table Row
exercises.notes: Own the positions and stop well before form slips.

substitutionOptions.name: Doorway Towel Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if it is your safest row option.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if no body row setup is available.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Stay stacked and breathe behind the brace.

substitutionOptions.name: Hard Front Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if side planks are still too shaky.

exercises.name: Shadowboxing Conditioning
